moong-sprouts.name: Moong sprouts (home, short sprout)
moong-sprouts.note: home short-sprout (~2.2x dry weight); weigh sprouted. Store-bought long moong sprouts are far lighter (~30 kcal/100g)

turbinado-sugar.name: Turbinado sugar (Sugar In The Raw)
turbinado-sugar.note: Household product: Sugar In The Raw. Nutrition uses NCCDB Turbinado Sugar food id 455706 to avoid branded-label rounding distortion.

moth-sprouts.name: Matki / moth bean sprouts (home)
moth-sprouts.note: home short-sprout (~2.2x dry weight); weigh sprouted. Store-bought long moong sprouts are far lighter (~30 kcal/100g)

chana-sprouts.name: Kala chana sprouts (home)
chana-sprouts.note: home short-sprout (~2.2x dry weight); weigh sprouted. Store-bought long moong sprouts are far lighter (~30 kcal/100g)

psyllium-husk.name: Psyllium husk
psyllium-husk.note: 1 tbsp ≈ 5 g. Almost entirely fiber; contributes little usable energy.

chaat-masala.name: Chaat masala
chaat-masala.note: Mostly salt + amchur. 1 tsp ≈ 3 g; nutrition impact negligible.

lemon-juice.name: Lemon juice (fresh)
lemon-juice.note: Juice of half a lemon ≈ 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g

monk-fruit-sweetener.name: Monk fruit allulose blend (Whole Earth)
monk-fruit-sweetener.note: Whole Earth Monk Fruit Allulose Blend. Allulose is largely non-metabolised (~0.4 kcal/g); carbs shown are mostly non-glycemic.

dragon-fruit-blend.name: Frozen smoothie blend (Fresh Start Tropical Dragon Fruit)

creatine.name: Creatine monohydrate
creatine.note: Non-caloric; ~5 g per scoop. Listed for completeness only.

asafoetida.name: Asafoetida (hing)
asafoetida.note: Used in pinches; nutrition impact negligible.

mothbean-cooked.name: Moth beans, whole, cooked (boiled)
mothbean-cooked.note: Cooked whole moth beans (matki), not home sprouts — see [[moth-sprouts]] for the sprouted version.

enchilada-sauce.name: Red enchilada sauce (e.g. Old El Paso)

taco-seasoning.name: Taco seasoning mix (e.g. Old El Paso)

fairlife-nutrition-plan.name: Fairlife Nutrition Plan 30g shake
fairlife-nutrition-plan.note: 1 bottle = 340 g = 150 kcal / 30 g protein. Confirmed 2026-09-03.

milk-fatfree-natures-promise.name: Fat-free (skim) milk — Nature's Promise Organic
milk-fatfree-natures-promise.note: Values from USDA skim milk (Cronometer food id 168, true grams, 245 g/cup). Log it as that entry. Cronometer's branded 'Nature's Promise, Organic, Fat Free Milk' (id 75460528) has a correct 240 ml cup, but its gram unit is rescaled (~0.417 per ml, so 100 units = 1 cup and per-100-unit nutrition is one cup's label). Its per-cup nutrition is fine; only gram quantities are wrong, over-counting ~2.4x. Log that entry by the Cup measure or not at all.

recipes.name: Besan chilla with paneer stuffing
steps: Thin besan batter with water, salt, turmeric, ajwain.
Cook 2 chilla; stuff with spiced crumbled paneer.
Serve with mint chutney.

recipes.name: Moong dal chilla
steps: Mix moong dal flour, sooji, psyllium, spices, salt and sweetener; add water to a pourable batter and rest 10-15 min.
Fold in crumbled tofu, onion, tomato, green pepper and green chili.
Cook thin chillas on a hot tawa with a little Graza EVOO, both sides.
Batch is ~725 g cooked. Take ~75 g aside (daughter/dad); split the rest two ways, ~325 g each.
recipes.notes: Full batch (725 g cooked) = 1081 kcal / 63 g protein / 162 g carb / 26 g fat / 37 g fiber. Per 325 g portion (each of us, after 75 g set aside) = 485 kcal / 28 P / 73 C / 12 F / 17 fiber. The 75 g side portion = 112 kcal / 7 P. Oil is an estimate (1 tbsp Graza EVOO) - adjust in Library if you used more/less. App 'per serving' = full batch / 2 (~540 kcal, the no-side case); use the 325 g Portion readout for the real per-plate number.

recipes.name: Masala oats with paneer

ingredients.note: cubes, stirred in at the end

steps: Cook oats in milk with jeera, turmeric, veg.
Fold in paneer off heat.

recipes.name: Protein poha
steps: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil; add peanuts, onion.
Add soaked soya granules, then poha, turmeric, salt, lime.

recipes.name: Soya keema sabzi
steps: Soak granules in hot water 10 min, squeeze dry.
Brown onion in oil; add ginger-garlic, tomato, keema masala.
Add soya and peas; cook 10 min.
recipes.notes: Highest protein-per-calorie dish in the database. The one to cook weekly.

recipes.name: Protein toor dal (soya-boosted)
steps: Pressure-cook dal with soya granules and turmeric.
Gujarati tadka: ghee, mustard, hing, curry leaves; balance sweet-sour lightly.
recipes.notes: Granules disappear into the dal. ~2x the protein of plain dal.

recipes.name: Paneer bhurji
steps: Sauté onion, capsicum; add tomato and pav-bhaji or garam masala.
Crumble in paneer, cook 3-4 min.
recipes.notes: Swap to whole-milk paneer: +115 kcal/serving. Swap to tofu-firm 300 g for the lighter version.

recipes.name: Tofu bhurji
steps: Same method as paneer bhurji; press tofu first, finish with kasuri methi.

recipes.name: Chole masala
steps: Pressure-cook chana with tea bag for color.
Onion-tomato masala with chole masala; simmer 15 min.
recipes.notes: Pair with Fage raita (150 g = 89 kcal / 15 g protein) to lift the meal's protein.

recipes.name: Palak paneer (light)
steps: Blanch and purée spinach.
Cook masala, add purée, milk, then paneer cubes.

recipes.name: Gujarati kadhi (Greek yogurt)

ingredients.note: whisked with water to buttermilk consistency

steps: Whisk yogurt, besan, water smooth; simmer gently, stirring.
Temper: ghee, mustard, methi seeds, curry leaves, ginger-chili; light jaggery to taste.
recipes.notes: Fage swap roughly doubles the protein of dahi kadhi at fewer calories.

recipes.name: Sprouted moong chaat
steps: Toss everything with lime, chaat masala, coriander.

recipes.name: Shrikhand (Greek yogurt)
steps: Whisk yogurt with sweetener, cardamom, saffron soaked in 1 tsp warm milk.
Chill 30 min; top with pistachio.
recipes.notes: Real shrikhand at a third of the calories. ~17 g protein per serving.

recipes.name: Date-cocoa protein ladoo
steps: Blitz dates to a paste; knead everything together.
Roll 8 ladoos; refrigerate. 1 serving = 1 ladoo.
recipes.notes: ~135 kcal / 9 g protein per ladoo. Batch keeps 2 weeks refrigerated.

recipes.name: Chocolate yogurt mousse
steps: Whisk everything until glossy; chill 1 hour.
Optional berries on top.
recipes.notes: ~190 kcal / 29 g protein per serving — a dessert that doubles as the fourth feeding.

recipes.name: Tofu paratha

ingredients.note: pressed dry, grated into the dough

steps: Press tofu 10 min, grate, knead into atta with onion, chili, salt, ajwain — the tofu replaces most of the water.
Roll 2 parathas; cook on a hot tawa with a light brush of oil.
Serve with Fage raita (adds ~15 g protein per 150 g).
recipes.notes: Tofu disappears into the dough — same paratha taste, nearly double the protein of plain.

recipes.name: Paneer paratha (loaded)

ingredients.note: whole-milk paneer, crumbled for the stuffing
~2 tbsp Bob's Red Mill flaxseed meal

steps: Knead a soft dough: wheat flour, barley flour, besan, flaxseed meal, psyllium husk, salt, olive oil, water.
Stuffing: crumbled whole-milk paneer with chopped baby spinach, green chilli, cilantro, salt.
Stuff, roll gently, cook both sides on a hot tawa with a light brush of oil.
Batch makes 4.5 parathas — 1 serving = 1 paratha.
recipes.notes: Harsh's actual recipe (replaces the old generic seed). Batch of 4.5 parathas ≈ 1195 kcal / 49 g protein / 25 g fiber; per paratha ≈ 265 kcal / 11 g protein / 5.7 g fiber. Two flours + flax + psyllium + besan make it much higher-fiber than a plain paneer paratha.

recipes.name: Tofu-atta rotis (batch of 5)

ingredients.note: pressed, blended smooth, kneaded in as the water

steps: Blend pressed tofu smooth; knead into atta (add water only if needed).
Rest 15 min; roll and cook 5 rotis as usual.
1 serving = 1 rotli.
recipes.notes: Protein rotli: ~87 kcal / 4.4 g protein each vs 105 / 3.5 for plain — swap into any meal.

recipes.name: Methi-tofu thepla
steps: Knead everything with turmeric, chili powder, salt, a pinch of jaggery.
Roll thin; cook 2 theplas with a light brush of oil.
Travels well — good tiffin food.
recipes.notes: Classic Gujarati thepla with tofu smuggled in — +6 g protein over plain methi thepla.

recipes.name: Besan dhokla (steamed)
steps: Whisk besan, rava, yogurt, water, turmeric, salt, sugar to idli-batter consistency; rest 15 min.
Add 1 tsp Eno, pour into a greased plate, steam 15 min.
Temper: oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chili + 2 tbsp water; pour over. Coriander on top.
recipes.notes: Steamed, not fried — the oil in the vaghar is the only fat lever.

recipes.name: Gatte ki sabzi (Greek yogurt gravy)
steps: Knead besan with salt, chili, ajwain, 1 tsp of the yogurt and a little water; roll into logs, boil 10 min, slice into gatte.
Temper oil with jeera, garlic, ginger; add whisked yogurt + boiling water off heat, stirring (keeps it from splitting).
Simmer gatte in the gravy 5–7 min.
recipes.notes: Fage replaces dahi in the gravy — nearly triple the protein of the standard version.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka (oven/air-fryer)
steps: Marinate paneer + veg in yogurt, tandoori masala, kasuri methi, salt, lemon — 30 min.
Air-fry or bake at 200°C ~12 min, turning once; brush with oil.
Finish with chaat masala.
recipes.notes: A 250-kcal dinner anchor with 24 g protein. Pair with tofu-atta rotis.

recipes.name: Paneer frankie wrap
steps: Cook a large thin roti.
Sauté crumbled paneer with pav bhaji masala; make a quick mint-yogurt spread.
Assemble: spread, paneer, veg, onion, a squeeze of lime; roll tight.
recipes.notes: 31 g protein in one hand. The whole lunch, no sides needed.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt protein bowl
steps: Layer everything in a bowl. Done in 2 minutes.
Optional: cinnamon or cardamom on top.
recipes.notes: The no-blender fallback breakfast — 26 g protein, zero cooking.

recipes.name: Cucumber raita (Fage)
steps: Whisk Fage 0% smooth with roasted cumin, salt, chaat masala, lemon.
Fold in grated cucumber, green chilli and cilantro; chill.
Batch makes 2 servings.
recipes.notes: All Fage 0% (do not use whole-milk yogurt). Batch ≈ 228 kcal / 29 g protein; per serving ≈ 114 kcal / 14.5 g protein / 2.2 g fiber. More cucumber and a full cup of yogurt vs the old version.

recipes.name: Besan-stuffed colored peppers

ingredients.note: 3 mini/baby sweet peppers, ~20-22 g each raw (NOT full-size bell peppers)

steps: Mix besan with salt, chili powder and a pinch of monk fruit allulose blend.
Halve/deseed the peppers, pack with the besan mix.
Dry-roast or bake with no oil until the peppers soften and the besan is cooked.
1 serving = 3 mini stuffed peppers; scale ingredients for a larger batch.
recipes.notes: Harsh's recipe, logged as eaten (no oil). Uses mini/baby sweet peppers, not bell peppers. 3 mini peppers ≈ 55 kcal / 2.7 g protein / 2 g fiber — the besan filling is now the bigger share. Weigh a raw pepper to calibrate: ~20 g each.

recipes.name: Roasted makhana-chana mix
steps: Dry-roast makhana until crisp (5–6 min, low flame).
Toss everything with oil, salt, turmeric, chili powder while warm.
Keeps 2 weeks airtight.
recipes.notes: The chai-time replacement for farsan — 8 g protein per handful-and-a-half.

recipes.name: Smoothie dragon
steps: Blend everything with ice/water to taste.
The bigger sibling of Protein smoothie — used on days without whey/creatine.
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81206196. Batch makes 2 servings; 1 serving (362 g) ≈ 492 kcal / 23.5 g protein / 52.5 g carbs / 24 g fat / 10.9 g fiber. This is the variant Harsh had for breakfast on 2026-08-31 instead of Protein smoothie.

recipes.name: Protein smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice/water.
The daily version — whey + creatine.
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81102418. Strawberries and cocoa removed and NuttZo raised to 1 tbsp on 2026-09-03 (household does not add berries/cocoa). Recompute from ingredients ≈ 427 kcal / 44 g protein / 29 g carbs / 16 g fat / 5.4 g fiber per serving (418 g); recalibrate against Cronometer once the saved recipe there is updated.

recipes.name: Protein smoothie — loaded (fat-free milk, nuts + seeds)

ingredients.note: 1/2 cup — swapped in for almond milk
1/2 tbsp NuttZo — halved 2026-09-04 to cut calories

steps: Blend everything with ice/water.
Loaded sibling of Protein smoothie — fat-free dairy milk instead of almond milk, plus soaked almonds, popped amaranth and cinnamon, with a half-dose of NuttZo.
recipes.notes: Derived from protein-smoothie; trimmed 2026-09-04 to cut calories without losing protein: dropped tahini, coconut and walnuts, halved NuttZo (16 g -> 8 g), kept soaked almonds, popped amaranth, cinnamon and the fat-free-milk swap. Built as a real Cronometer recipe from database ingredients in both accounts and verified against Cronometer's own engine on 2026-09-04: 476.4 kcal / 48.6 g protein / 39.0 g carbs / 16.3 g fat / 7.5 g fiber per serving (424.6 g). Local per100g computation agrees to within rounding.

recipes.name: Besan paratha (tofu dough)
steps: Knead besan, wheat flour, grated tofu, Fage, ginger-garlic-chilli, ajwain, turmeric, hing, sweetener into a soft dough.
Roll and cook parathas on a hot tawa.
Batch makes ~9 parathas; 1 serving = 1 paratha (~39 g).
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81153431. Per paratha ≈ 66 kcal / 4.5 g protein — very light because the batch is spread across ~9.

recipes.name: Jowar rotla
steps: Mix jowar flour, barley flour, flax meal and psyllium; bind with hot water into a dough.
Pat out rotlas by hand and cook on a hot tawa; smear with ghee.
Batch ≈ 5 rotlas; 1 serving = 1 rotla.
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81143027. Full batch (365 g) ≈ 1503 kcal / 33 g protein / 40 g fiber; per rotla ≈ 300 kcal. Cronometer logs it as '1 full recipe' — adjust servings to your rotla count.

recipes.name: Strawberry protein shake
steps: Blend milk, whey and strawberries with ice.
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81141209. ≈ 268 kcal / 32.5 g protein per shake.

recipes.name: Chhaas (spiced buttermilk)
steps: Whisk Fage 0% with cold water to a drinkable consistency.
Season with roasted cumin, salt and a squeeze of lemon; serve chilled.
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81123667. ≈ 74 kcal / 13 g protein per glass (before water).

recipes.name: Sprouted moth (matki) sabzi
steps: Temper the cooked moth beans in peanut oil with mustard seeds, hing, curry leaves, salt and lime.
Batch ≈ 4 servings (~70 g each).
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81120598. Per serving ≈ 107 kcal / 5 g protein.

recipes.name: Tandaljo bhaji (amaranth greens)
steps: Temper cumin and methi seeds in oil; add onion and cook down.
Add potato, then chopped amaranth leaves, turmeric, chilli powder, salt; cook covered until soft.
Batch ≈ 4 servings (~170 g each).
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81120118. Per serving ≈ 192 kcal / 4 g protein / 6 g fiber. Salt and chilli powder are heavy in this one — sodium ~1980 mg/serving.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon yogurt bowl
steps: Dice the apple and toss with the cinnamon.
Spoon over the yogurt; top with chia, chopped dates and almonds.
No cook — about 3 minutes.
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81420429 (logged 2026-09-02). One bowl ≈ 323 kcal / 21 g protein / 58 g carbs / 7 g fat / 10 g fiber. Apple and date amounts are the main estimate; adjust to taste.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese toast
steps: Toast the bread. Spread cottage cheese thick on each slice.
Top with tomato, drizzle olive oil, scatter the seed mix, crack of pepper and flaky salt.
Batch = 2 servings. Heads-up: the seasoning/salt makes this a high-sodium meal (~1500 mg for the batch).
recipes.notes: Imported from Cronometer recipe #81323132 (logged 2026-09-01). Full batch ≈ 617 kcal / 32 g protein / 62 g carbs / 31 g fat / 14 g fiber; per serving ≈ 310 kcal / 16 g protein. Ingredient list reconstructed to match those totals (±10%).

recipes.name: Lahsooni palak paneer with pea rice
steps: Pea rice: temper cumin in oil, saute onion, add peas and cooked basmati, season, keep warm.
Palak paneer: brown the garlic in ghee (go heavy — lahsooni), add onion then tomato puree and cashews, cook down.
Stir in the spinach puree, simmer, fold in paneer, finish with cream.
Serve the palak paneer over the pea rice — the rice carries the carbs, the paneer the protein. Batch = 3 plates.
recipes.notes: Combined from two Cronometer recipes logged 2026-09-01: Lahsooni palak paneer #81345232 (batch ≈ 1180 kcal / 62 g protein / 87 g fat) + Pea rice #81354146 (≈ 254 kcal / 10 g protein / 53 g carbs per portion, 2 portions here). Combined batch ≈ 1760 kcal / 79 g protein / 153 g carbs / 96 g fat / 20 g fiber; per plate ≈ 585 kcal / 26 g protein. Ingredient lists reconstructed to match Cronometer totals (±10%).

recipes.name: Tofu enchiladas
steps: Crumble/cube the super-firm tofu, toss with 1 tbsp taco seasoning, brown in the olive oil.
Add onion, peppers and tomato; saute until soft. Stir in the rest of the seasoning.
Spread refried beans down each almond-flour tortilla, fill with the tofu-veg mix, roll and place seam-down in a baking dish.
Pour over the enchilada sauce, scatter the Mexican cheese, bake ~15 min at 200C until bubbling.
Batch = 2 servings (2 enchiladas each). Serve with the guacamole.
recipes.notes: Added from Harsh & Vruddhi's dinner 2026-09-02. Batch (2 servings) ≈ 1215 kcal / 53 g protein / 117 g carbs / 70 g fat / 32 g fiber; per serving ≈ 608 kcal / 26 g protein / 58 g carbs / 35 g fat. Branded per-100g values are label estimates — calibrate against Cronometer.

recipes.name: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocado to the texture you like.
Fold in tomato, onion, garlic, cilantro and the lime juice; salt to taste.
Batch = 2 servings. Pairs with the tofu enchiladas.
recipes.notes: Added from Harsh & Vruddhi's dinner 2026-09-02. Batch (2 servings) ≈ 263 kcal / 4 g protein / 18 g carbs / 22 g fat / 11 g fiber; per serving ≈ 132 kcal / 2 g protein / 9 g carbs / 11 g fat.

recipes.name: Fairlife Nutrition Plan shake
steps: Open bottle. Drink.
recipes.notes: Afternoon protein filler. ~150 kcal / 30 g protein per bottle. Label numbers confirmed by Harsh 2026-09-03.

recipes.name: Sooji halva
steps: Roast the sooji and whole-wheat flour in the ghee until aromatic; add the almonds and raisins.
Add the turbinado sugar and hot water gradually, stirring until absorbed and the halva is cooked through.
Weigh the finished batch at 520 g. Portion in 50 g servings.
recipes.notes: Measured cooked yield 520 g; 1 serving = 50 g and the batch makes 10.4 servings. Volume conversions: 1/2 cup ghee = 104 g, 2 tbsp whole-wheat flour = 15 g, and 1/2 cup turbinado sugar = 96 g. App estimate per 50 g serving ≈ 178 kcal / 1.7 g protein / 18.6 g carbs / 11.0 g fat / 0.8 g fiber.
